column7: Complete span-fill wrapper: save driver state, configure page and colour, initialize two row-bound arrays using REP STOSW, invoke span draw, restore driver state and saved registers; cross-checked with START twin.

String-search return followed by near/far byte fills, byte copy, far-to-near REP MOVSB and word comparison; argument increments, counted loops and shared comparison exits read.

Continuation and steep-major arm of the same packed two-bit line renderer: signed row-step table updates, error accumulator, mask rotations, loop bounds and common register-restoring RET read.
